text:
carla: running into intermittent JSON.parse throws in sampleapp-js streams. repro steps: start stream, force short network glitch during token refresh, reconnect.

ben: which client path? EventSource or fetch-stream?

carla: fetch-stream via the sdk (0.9.x). observed in local + staging behind alb/traefik.

hiro: any raw capture?

carla: curl -v -N capture (tokens redacted):

```
> GET /stream HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: text/event-stream
: keepalive
data: {"id":"n1","v":1}


{"id":"n2","v":2}

```

carla: parser currently splits on "\n\n" and concatenates lines that start with "data:". when a stray CRLF appears between chunks the leading '{' of the next JSON can be interpreted as continuation, causing parse error.

maya: sounds like a boundary normalization bug combined with our abort/reconnect timing. quick mitigation: 1) normalize CRLF -> LF on incoming bytes, 2) ignore lines starting with ':' (keepalive), 3) clear any partial buffer immediately when fetch is aborted before reconnect.

ben: agree. also add a small defensive retry: if JSON.parse fails and the string has leading non-printable chars, trim and retry once while emitting a metric. don't swallow errors though.

hiro: will check edge config: traefik/alb flags that affect streaming buffering and whether the TLS terminator rewrites line endings. could be coalescing writes.

carla: implemented local fix with CRLF normalization + discard-on-abort. in a 5k-iteration flapper harness error rate dropped from ~7% to ~0.5%. still occasional failure when refresh and keepalive align within ~20ms.

ben: open PR with unit tests simulating interleaved keepalives, abort+reconnect, and CRLF-injected chunks. add metric parse_error{near_refresh=true}. mark P2 because unguarded consumers may crash.

ci-bot: CI green for branch fix/sse-resync (8/8) :white_check_mark:

maya: after merge, backport to 0.9.x and add a short troubleshooting note in sampleapp README explaining how to curl -v -N and look for stray CRLFs between events.

hiro: I'll flip streaming buffering off in staging on traefik and run the flapper test.

carla: thanks — gist with minimal repro + harness linked (internal). will monitor metrics post-deploy and follow up if >0.2% parse errors.
